definition: foolish in a funny, ludicrous way
description: A young man with curly hair in an open cream shirt walks a whitewashed island street and lifts a pair of round dark sunglasses onto his face. He stops at a spinning rack of sunglasses outside a shop, tries on a pair of aviators, and then puts on enormous red heart-shaped sunglasses that cover half his face. He walks on to the harbour and poses proudly beside a blue and white fishing boat, pointing at himself while still wearing them.

en.question: What is the young man wearing?

de.answer: Er trägt eine alberne rote Sonnenbrille.
de.question: Was trägt der junge Mann?

es.answer: Lleva puestas unas gafas de sol rojas y ridículas.
es.question: ¿Qué lleva puesto el joven?

fr.answer: Il porte de drôles de lunettes de soleil rouges.
